decisions.decision: Voluntary toll request by the Teen Center cannot be voted tonight because it was not on the agenda; it could be voted at the next BOS meeting.
decisions.quote: however, the voluntary toll could be voted on at the next bos meeting.

decisions.decision: Robert Ebersole volunteered to be the BOS liaison to the Library Committee and the Board of Health; Mr. Alonzo said that would work well.
decisions.quote: mr. ebersole volunteered to be the liaison from the bos to both groups.

decisions.decision: Town Manager Speidel offered to provide the BOS with a map of where the Water Department is serving compared to the Water District.
decisions.quote: ms. speidel said she was not sure if there was an official map but could provide the bos with such a map.

decisions.decision: Town Manager Speidel will research the Tri-Town extra funding question (40S / Chapter 70) further and had asked the Planning Board Director to follow up.
decisions.quote: ms. speidel will research this matter further.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Mr. Ebersole said the committee should consider demolishing the Passios Building, which he put at between $750,000.00 and $1,000,000.00, and compare that to repair and reuse costs.
budget_items.quote: additionally, the committee should also look at the option of demolition the passios building, which would cost between $750,000.00 and $1,000,000.00

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Warrants for 5/14/13 were listed on the agenda, including warrant #61-13 and a 4th Quarter Water Department Commitment; no vote on the warrants is recorded.
Ms. Bertram reported from the MPO meeting that the new Transportation Alternatives Program has about $75,000.00 per year in funding for non-Federally funded projects.
budget_items.quote: the program just started out and has funding of about $75,000.00 per year.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Mr. Alonzo asked whether the Town had seen the extra student funding Tri-Town was supposed to bring; Ms. Speidel said no separate funding was seen and that the Town may not have qualified for 40S funding in the first year.
budget_items.quote: tri-town which was built under 40r and 40s and was supposed to include extra funding for students and asked if the town had ever seen any extra funding.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Sharon McCullah said the Teen Center receives little funding and often has to fundraise itself, citing a 5K race and a proposed voluntary toll.
budget_items.quote: the teen center is a much needed service in town that does not receive much funding, so they often have to fundraise themselves.
